Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3356. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
